section.title: org.osgi.service.enocean
section.para: EnOcean Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.enocean; version="[1.0,2.0)"}
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.enocean; version="[1.0,1.1)"}

listitem.para: EnOceanChannel - Holds the raw value and channel identification info of an EnOceanChannel.
EnOceanDevice - This interface represents a physical device that communicates over the EnOcean protocol.
EnOceanEvent - Constants for use in EnOcean events.
EnOceanException - This class contains code and definitions necessary to support common EnOcean exceptions.
EnOceanHandler - The interface used to get callback answers from a RPC or a Message.
EnOceanHost - This interface represents an EnOcean Host, a device that offers EnOcean networking features.
EnOceanMessage - Holds the necessary methods to interact with an EnOcean message.
EnOceanRPC - A very basic interface for RPCs.

section.title: public class EnOceanException extends Exception
section.para: This class contains code and definitions necessary to support common EnOcean exceptions. This class is mostly used with low-level, gateway-interacting code : EnOceanHost.

section.title: public static final short ESP_RET_NOT_SUPPORTED = 2
section.para: Operation is not supported by the target device.

section.title: public static final short ESP_RET_OPERATION_DENIED = 4
section.para: The operation was denied.

section.title: public static final short ESP_RET_WRONG_PARAM = 3
section.para: One of the parameters was badly specified or missing.

section.title: public static final short ESP_UNEXPECTED_FAILURE = 1
section.para: Unexpected failure.

section.title: public static final short INVALID_TELEGRAM = 240
section.para: The message was invalid.

section.title: public static final short SUCCESS = 0
section.para: SUCCESS status code.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanHost
section.para: This interface represents an EnOcean Host, a device that offers EnOcean networking features.

section.title: public static final Object HOST_ID
section.para: The unique ID for this Host: this matches the CHIP_ID of the EnOcean Gateway Chip it embodies.

section.title: public static final int REPEATER_LEVEL_OFF = 0
section.para: repeater level to disable repeating; this is the default.

section.title: public static final int REPEATER_LEVEL_ONE = 1
section.para: repeater level to repeat every telegram at most once.

section.title: public static final int REPEATER_LEVEL_TWO = 2
section.para: repeater level to repeat every telegram at most twice.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanMessage
section.para: Holds the necessary methods to interact with an EnOcean message.

section.title: public abstract byte[][] getBytes()
section.para: Gets the bytes corresponding to the whole message, including the CRC. The generated byte[] array may be sent to an EnOcean gateway and is conform to EnOcean Radio Protocol.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The serialized byte list corresponding to the binary message.

section.title: public abstract int getDbm()
section.para: Returns the average RSSI on all the received subtelegrams, including redundant ones.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The average RSSI perceived.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the message's destination ID, or -1

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the message's FUNC

section.title: public abstract byte[][] getPayloadBytes()
section.para: Returns the payload bytes of this message.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: corresponding value.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the message's RORG

section.title: public abstract int getSecurityLevelFormat()
section.para: Returns the security level of this message, as specified in the 'Security of EnOcean Radio Networks' draft, section 4.2.1.3.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The security level format.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the message's Sender ID

section.title: public abstract int getStatus()
section.para: Gets the current EnOcean status of the Message. The 'status' byte is actually a bitfield that mainly holds repeater information, teach-in status, and more or less information depending on the radiotelegram type.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the current EnOcean status of this message.

section.title: public abstract int getSubTelNum()
section.para: Returns the number of subtelegrams (usually 1) this Message carries.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The number of subtelegrams in the case of multiframe messages.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the message's TYPE
